responsibility: Implements the low-level mutation operations for IPA reference edges between symtab nodes. It removes references while maintaining both the referring node’s reference vector and the referred node’s backpointer list, handles alias ordering constraints, and provides basic helpers to retrieve the owning reference lists or ask whether a reference can lead to return. This is the implementation companion to ipa-ref.h, not a higher-level reference-analysis pass.
same_name_distinction: Implements only the low-level behavior of the ipa_ref structures from ipa-ref.h, chiefly mutating/removing reference edges and navigating the paired forward/back-reference lists, not the higher-level static-variable reference analysis of ipa-reference.cc.
